legal_ref: CGI art. 278 (as amended by Loi n° 2012-1510 du 29 décembre 2012 de finances rectificative pour 2012, art. 68)
quote: Le taux normal est applicable à toutes les opérations pour lesquelles aucun autre taux n'est prévu. Il est fixé à 20 % pour la France métropolitaine et la Corse ( CGI, art. 278 ). — The standard rate applies to all transactions for which no other rate is provided; it is set at 20% for metropolitan France and Corsica.
source_title: BOFiP-Impôts BOI-TVA-LIQ-20 « TVA - Liquidation - Taux - Le taux normal » (DGFiP), version en vigueur du 19/09/2014; start date from Assemblée nationale, réponse ministérielle à la question écrite n° 16988 (14e législature): « A compter du 1er janvier 2014 ... article 68 de la loi n° 2012-1510 ... portant le taux normal de TVA de 19,6 % à 20 % » (https://www2.assemblee-nationale.fr/questions/detail/14/qe/16988/(vue)/pdf)

reduced_rates.scope: accommodation, restaurant/catering, cultural admissions, certain pharmaceuticals, housing provision/renovation, agricultural goods and services, water supply, TV broadcasting reception (CGI art. 279 ff.)

foodstuffs, cultural and sporting admissions, domestic care services, medical equipment for disabled persons, certain pharmaceuticals, social housing, solar panel installation, district heating (CGI art. 278-0 bis ff.)
newspapers and periodicals, reimbursable pharmaceuticals (CGI art. 281 quater ff.)

notes: Five main rates: 20% standard, 10% and 5.5% reduced, 2.1% particular rate, and zero rate (exemption with deduction, e.g. international passenger transport, exports and intra-EU supplies). Corsica has specific rates (13%, 10%, 2.1%, 0.9%). Overseas departments Guadeloupe, Martinique, Réunion: standard 8.5%, reduced 2.1%, plus 1.05% for some items; VAT not applicable in French Guiana and Mayotte (BOI-TVA-GEO). TEDB (situation 2026-07-01) also shows 20% standard. No enacted future change to the standard rate found in BOFiP or TEDB (TEDB query for 2027-01-01 still 20%).
unverified: Reduced-rate scopes summarised from TEDB categories and BOI-TVA-LIQ overview, not checked article by article against the CGI
Text of CGI art. 278 itself not read directly (Légifrance blocked automated access); quote is from DGFiP's official BOFiP commentary
